tmp:1909: birur ha-ruach tovah min ha-ruach ra'ah — the act of sifting/separating the good spirit (joy, prophecy) from the evil spirit within the mixed breath, effected by the skilled musician on a whole instrument
tmp:1914: nigl(ot) — 'the revealed things' of Deut 29:28 ('ve-hanniglot lanu u-levaneinu'), the disclosed dimension of Torah that becomes 'his Torah' (na'aseh) after the hidden stage
tmp:1915: the fall and nullification of malkhut ha-resha'ah — collapse of the wicked kingdom (Sitra Achra's dominion) when holy Malkhut (nun) is joined to Chokhmah (chet), 'when this rises, that falls'
tmp:1916: hitgalut ha-hitpa'arut — the revelation of God's glorying/adornment in His people Israel (pe'er, tefillin), whose disclosure by the tzaddik brings down fear and love
tmp:1917: nofel yirah — the 'falling' (descending/alighting) of awe-fear upon beholders, effected by the revealed pe'er/tefillin-glory of Israel ('all peoples will see... and fear you')
tmp:1918: the single (first) collapse of Sha'ar Aram — one fall of the Gate of Aram/Sitra Achra in R. Yosei ben Kisma's sign of Mashiach (it must fall three times before Ben David comes)
tmp:1919: the downfall of all seventy languages/nations — collapse of the shiv'im lashon when the good of Targum is raised into leshon ha-kodesh and its evil cast down (tardemah = gematria targum)
tmp:1921: nokem bo — the sin-engraved letter-combination 'takes vengeance' on the sinner; the punitive backlash of an evil tzeruf carved on his bones (Ezek 32:27)
tmp:1922: nizdakekh ha-avir — the purification/clarification of the air of the world, effected by the love and friendship acquired through giving tzedakah to many people
tmp:1923: nachal ha-nimshakh min ha-ma'yan — the stream flowing from the wellspring: Binah as river issuing from Chokhmah's point/yud-spring (the vav of the melupum)
tmp:1924: the upper point's division into three drops — the supernal nekudah (throne/Moshe) splitting into the three dots of segol, corresponding to teshuvah's three conditions: seeing, hearing, understanding-and-returning (Isa 6)
tmp:1925: nechkak bo emet — truth being engraved in a person through receiving and following the counsel of tzaddikim ('hen emet chafatzta,' Ps 51)
tmp:1926: the engraving (tav-mark) of a receptive place in the heart of the one petitioned — chen (chet+nun) carving room so requests are accepted, as in 'vehitvita tav' (Ezek 9)
tmp:1927: tanina — the sea-serpent/dragon (Aramaic, from the Rabbah bar bar Chanah tale) that swallowed; symbol of the nachash enticing one to pray for self-benefit
tmp:1928: dina dimsa'ava — 'impure judgment' (Aramaic Zoharic term): defiled din stemming from the serpent's contamination of Chavah, opposed to holy judgment/loving rebuke
tmp:1929: nachash hitil zuhama be-Chavah — the Talmudic dictum (Shabbat 146a) that the primordial serpent injected filth into Eve, source-event of impure judgment
tmp:1930: the heart's kindling and burning toward God — the state of inflamed devotional ardor arising in personal prayer/hitbodedut before one's Maker
tmp:1931: nit'har ha-lev — the purification of the heart ('lev tahor bera li,' Ps 51) achieved through private speech between oneself and one's Creator (ruach ha-kodesh)
tmp:1933: sippurei ma'asiyot mi-tzaddikim — telling stories of what actually happened to tzaddikim, a practice that purifies the hearer's thought
tmp:1934: minut — heresy/sectarian unbelief, the state of denial into which the heart is enticed, linked to Asaf's 'my feet nearly slipped' (Ps 73)
tmp:1935: natayu raglai — 'my feet slipped/turned aside' (Ps 73:2), Asaf's phrase for the feet-swerving that figures the lapse into minut (heresy)
tmp:1936: kedushot nefulot — 'fallen holinesses': degraded holy potentials (fallen sparks) awaiting elevation to their place through commerce (massa u-mattan)
tmp:1937: nitzotzot she-naflu — the fallen sparks of holiness (Lurianic term) scattered below, lifted and restored to their place via buying-and-selling
tmp:1938: Israel doing the will of the Omnipresent and being included in their Root — the purpose of creation: Israel's fulfilling His ratzon and re-cleaving into God, the Necessary Existent
tmp:1939: the inclusion of the whole world (created for Israel) in Necessary Existence — creation's elevation into chiyuv ha-metziut when Israel returns to its Root
tmp:1940: nikhlal libo be-lev ha-tzaddik — one's heart becoming incorporated into the true tzaddik's heart through soul-love attachment (hitkashrut), expelling the spirit of folly
tmp:1941: bittul be-emet — true self-nullification: the ego-annulment by which one's soul is absorbed into its Root in God, the Necessary Existent
tmp:1942: yedi'ah — knowledge/da'at whose completeness removes all lack, suffering, and exile ('if you have acquired da'at, what do you lack?')
tmp:1943: nikhlalim bo — being included/absorbed in Him (in complete Da'at/God), the state in which all deficiencies, troubles, and exile are resolved
tmp:1944: the mutual inclusion of left in right and right in left forming unity — reconciliation of semola/yemina (Korach vs. Aharon strife) achieved by hand-clapping
tmp:1945: lishpokh sicho bi-tefillah — pouring out one's speech in prayer before God, which stirs His mercies and opens the Supernal Heart to flow forth words
tmp:1946: the ingathering of all who were thrust out of Israel's holiness back into kedushah — nidchei Yisrael yechannes via self-sacrifice for kiddush Hashem, building holy speech
tmp:1947: nikhna ha-kaved lifnei ha-moach — the liver (seat of appetite/blood) being subdued before the brain through fasting, restoring wisdom's shining face
tmp:1949: niggun ba-yad — playing melody by hand upon an instrument (music-making with the hand), the act that subdues the imaginative faculty (medammeh)
tmp:1950: the subduing of the medammeh and consequent attainment of zikaron — the imaginative faculty humbled by hand-played melody, opening memory (devekut-awareness of the World to Come)
tmp:1951: nikhna ha-ruach di-klipah — the subjugation of the spirit of the husk (klipah's tallit/ruach) by the holy tallit-encompassment (makif, ruach chayim) and the 13 Attributes of Mercy
tmp:1952: mizbeach ke-tikkuno — the altar in its proper order, i.e., eating in fitting kashrut/propriety ('one's table atones like an altar'), which starves the klipot
tmp:1953: nikhna'im ha-klipot, haynu ha-kesilut — the subjugation of the husks, i.e., the foolishness of the intellect, effected by the altar-aspect of proper eating
tmp:1954: iyyun ba-Torah until grasping its chokhmot — deep analytic Torah study attaining the Torah's wisdoms, producing anpin nehirin (shining countenance) that subdues gentile traits and lusts
tmp:1956: nimmol levavam — the circumcision of the heart: removal of its orlah (foreskin/blockage), creating a hollow in the heart that truly feels the pain of one's sins
